run_flop_analysis: run flop count analysis on a detectron2 model using a config file and model weights
run_activation_analysis: run activation count analysis on a detectron2 model across multiple input samples
run_parameter_count: run parameter count analysis on a detectron2 model from a config file
run_structure_analysis: run model structure analysis to print the detectron2 model architecture
